description: An unknown constructor label becomes a property, as if the class declared it and assigned it last
code:
class Shape(type):
    this.type = type
shape1 = Shape(type="SQUARE", color="RED")
assert(shape1, {"id": "shape1", "type": "SQUARE", "color": "RED"})
[shape1.type, shape1.color]

description: A class without parameters or a body keeps every labeled attribute of its instances
code:
class Point
origin = Point(x=0, y=0)
corner = Point(x=3, y=4)
assert(origin, {"id": "origin", "x": 0, "y": 0})
Point.map(point -> point.x + point.y)

description: Unknown labels are assigned once the constructor statements finish, so a label replaces what the body set, even after a return
code:
class Lamp(room):
    this.room = room
    this.watts = 40
    if room == "attic":
        return
    this.lit = true
hall = Lamp(room="hall")
desk = Lamp(room="desk", watts=60, color="WARM")
attic = Lamp(room="attic", watts=25)
assert(hall, {"id": "hall", "room": "hall", "watts": 40, "lit": true})
assert(attic, {"id": "attic", "room": "attic", "watts": 25})
[desk.watts, desk.color, desk.lit]

description: A bodyless subclass passes unknown labels to the inherited constructor, and super forwards its own
code:
class Animal(name):
    this.name = name
class Dog: Animal
    pass
class Puppy(age): Animal
    super(name="Rex", sound="yip")
    this.age = age
fido = Dog(name="Fido", sound="woof")
rex = Puppy(age=1, toy="ball")
assert(fido, {"id": "fido", "name": "Fido", "sound": "woof"})
[rex.name, rex.sound, rex.age, rex.toy]

description: Adopted init signatures, with a block or an expression body, take unknown labels after their declared parameters
Class-level rules read properties from unknown labels and follow their changes
code:
class Order(item):
    this.item = item
$Order.total = $Order.price * $Order.count
order = Order(item="tea", price=4, count=2)
assert(order.total, 8)
order.count = 5
order.total

description: Unknown label values are snapshots and never assign caller variables
code:
class Note
color = "BLUE"
tag = "draft"
note = Note(color="RED", label=tag)
tag = "final"
assert([note.color, note.label, color], ["RED", "draft", "BLUE"])
note.label

description: A repeated unknown label is rejected before any value runs, and a failing value builds nothing
code:
class Shape(type):
    this.type = type
events = {count: 0}
duplicate = ""
try:
    Shape(color=(events.count=1), color="BLUE")
catch error:
    duplicate = error
missed = ""
try:
    Shape(type="SQUARE", color=missing)
catch error:
    missed = error
[duplicate, missed, events.count, Shape.length]
return: ["TypeError: Duplicate constructor argument 'color' for Shape","ReferenceError: missing is not defined",0,0]
